Firms or enterprises

  • Some key definitions:

    • Enterprise: “An economic unit that produces goods and services, made up of one or more establishments, which has the capacity in its own right to own assets, incur liabilities and carry out economic activities and transactions with other units.” (DANE, 2024, p. 92)

    • Establishment: “An economic unit with facilities defined by constructions that are permanently located in the same place, in which factors and resources are combined for the development of one or more economic activities.” (DANE, 2024, p. 92)

  • Some key definitions in the context of manufacturing, assuming the unit of observation is the establishment and the data is reported yearly:

    • Aggregate value (Valor Agregado): Gross Production (Producción Bruta) - Intermediate Consumption (Consumo Intermedio) (DANE, 2024, p. 32)

    • Gross Production (Producción Bruta) (DANE, 2024, p. 28):

      • Value of all products, byproducts and work manufactured by the establishment in the year (+)
      • Value of electrical energy sold (+)
      • Value of subsidies accrued (causados) in the year (+)
      • Value of inventories of products in the process of manufacture at year end (+)
      • Value of products in the process of manufacture at the beginning of the year (-)

  • Some key definitions in the context of manufacturing, assuming the unit of observation is the establishment and the data is reported yearly:

    • Intermediate Consumption: Value of non-durable goods and services used as inputs in the production process to produce other goods and services (Consumo Intermedio) (DANE, 2024, p. 29)

      • For a detailed list about the variables included when calculating intermediate consumption check out (DANE, 2024, pp. 29–31)

Flows and stocks

  • Stock: a variable that is measured at a particular point in time

  • Flow: a variable that is measured over a period of time
